title: ImPacks progressive foil tear draft
status: Interactive motion prototype; production integration pending
assetSource: Exact user-supplied black-and-gold ImPacks wrapper, October 11, 2026. PNG preserved; WebP encodes the same artwork with alpha.

beats.name: Slow tension
beats.motion: Subtle foil wobble, scale and perspective tilt

beats.name: First tear
beats.motion: Tear advances from the left notch to 22% width along an irregular one-pixel edge; the untouched right side stays sealed

beats.name: Second pull
beats.motion: Tear advances to 65%; released foil curls in a textured 3D surface, showing metallic underside and local creases

beats.name: Fast final rip
beats.motion: Tear accelerates across the remaining width; detached strip releases from 3370ms and clears by 3660ms

beats.name: Rarity bloom
beats.motion: Colored light, rays, expanding ring and finite particles

beats.name: Lift out
beats.motion: Card lifts toward upright; wrapper drops away; card visible from 3480ms

beats.name: Face-up flip
beats.motion: Card turns 180 degrees around Y while settling upright

beats.name: Settle
beats.motion: Hold readable card with soft residual aura

rarityCaveat: Illustrative visual treatments only. Current contracts do not define rarity or rarity odds. Do not infer rarity from market probability or order status.
accessibility: Native keyboard controls and phase announcements. Reduced-motion playback jumps to the final card. Manual chapter selection shows static states.
productionHandoff: Animate only returned, server-selected cards. Replay must never repeat a purchase or draw. Preserve quote ownership, retry identity and actual order status. This draft shows one illustrative card; integrate the three returned cards separately.

tearing.path: Deterministic multiscale jagged edge with short laminate fibers
tearing.deformation: Perspective-projected textured foil mesh with depth sorting, curling cross sections, surface lighting and silver back face
tearing.attachment: Only traversed columns detach; all remaining columns retain their original positions
tearing.release: Strip flies away only after the tear reaches the right edge
tearing.scope: Visual approximation of flexible foil; not a physical fracture simulation
